title: Four Riders: 44 Track Western Music Pack
tagline: 44 western music tracks for any game engine. Each rider has their own instrument.
description:
Four Riders is a 44 track western music pack for any game engine: a frontier score cast like a film, with one instrument for each of four riders.

It ships 38 full looping pieces and 6 short cues as OGG and editable MIDI, royalty free for commercial games, with three full tracks free on this page.

What is inside

44 tracks · 38 loops · 6 cues · OGG + editable MIDI · 63:10

  • Five acts across one territory: The Territory (8), The Town (12), The Trail (6), The Trouble (9) and Sundown (3), plus 6 cues: Wanted, The Draw, Gold Strike, New Day, Justice and Six Feet Under.
  • The cast: the Stranger on harmonica (13 tracks), the Outlaw on clean electric guitar (12 tracks), the Marshal on French horn (12 tracks) and the Widow on cello (13 tracks). Each instrument sounds only in that rider's scenes, stating that rider's own theme, so you can score a scene by who is in it. album.json lists the riders of every track.
  • The land: a whistle leads the 7 empty country tracks and sounds nowhere else. When it plays, no rider is there.
  • The meeting: all four instruments sound together in exactly three tracks, Four Riders, The Standoff and Four Roads Out, where the tune passes from rider to rider.
  • Hoofbeats: 5 riding tracks carry a woodblock part of its own (The Long Ride, Stagecoach, Cattle Drive, Riders on the Ridge and The Posse). Drop it from the MIDI if a scene wants no horse.
  • One seed theme, The Trail, in all 44 tracks, beside a theme for each rider, one for the land and one for the town.
  • Every full piece loops (the shortest loop is 52.0 seconds), with LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags in its OGG file.
  • 29 General MIDI instruments, among them banjo, honky tonk piano, trumpet, nylon guitar, steel guitar, tango accordion, tubular bells and choir aahs.

The theory and audio reports (788 and 510 checks, 0 failed) ship inside the download.

The scene sheet: every track against the four riders, the land and the hooves, read from the shipped MIDI.

The cast: each rider's instrument, their theme drawn from its notes, and what the files count.

The score sheet: all 44 tracks, from Four Riders to Six Feet Under.

Works with

RPG Maker MV and MZ read the loop tags with no plugin. The Readme gives import steps for Godot 4 (followed in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files), Unity and GameMaker. Any engine that plays OGG can use the files, and the MIDI lets you score it with your own sounds.

For the gunshots, spurs and saloon of the same world: Sixgun, our western sound effects pack.

Try it free

Three full tracks with their MIDI are free on this page: Red Mesa (the whistle, no rider), Five Card Hand (the Stranger on harmonica over the Outlaw on electric guitar) and The Standoff (all four, taking turns). More free tracks from our other albums: Overture, the free sampler.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. Do not resell the tracks as music assets. Every track is composed in code and rendered through a General MIDI soundfont; no generative audio model was used. The code and the cover art were made with AI tools. Every tune was composed for this record; no game or film cue is quoted.

Versions

v1.0 (31 October 2026): first release, 44 tracks.

devlog.title: Four Riders is out: a 44 track western score cast like a film
devlog.body:
Four Riders is a 44 track music pack for western games: one frontier territory from the open range through the town, the trail and the trouble to sundown, plus 6 short cues. It is live now, $9.99, with three full tracks free on the page.

The idea. Each of four riders has one instrument: The Stranger on harmonica, The Outlaw on clean electric guitar, The Marshal on French horn and The Widow on cello. An instrument sounds only in that rider's scenes, stating that rider's own theme, so a scene can be scored by who is in it. Empty country gets a whistle and no rider. All four sound together in exactly three tracks, where the tune passes from one to the next.

How it was checked. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, with the reports inside the download. Which instrument sounds in which track, which theme each rider states and the loop tags were each measured on the shipped files, and the loop tags were followed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project.

The renders are a General MIDI reference render; the MIDI is there so you can move it to your own sounds, or drop the hoofbeats. No game or film cue is quoted. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model was used; the cover art was made with AI tools.

https://csaf.itch.io/four-riders
